facts.statement: The new treatment plans used a technique called intensity-modulated radiotherapy to deliver a total dose of 30 Gy in 10 sessions, aiming to meet specific safety and effectiveness standards.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The researchers measured the radiation dose delivered to the target area and to sensitive structures including the hippocampi, optic nerves, optic chiasm, and lenses.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: To check the accuracy of the treatment, the plans were delivered to a specialized detector array that is compatible with the MRI machine.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Every treatment plan created for the new machine met the required safety limits for both the tumor target and the surrounding healthy organs.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The average radiation dose to the target volume was 35.49 Gy for the highest dose area and 26.85 Gy for the lowest dose area.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The average maximum dose to the hippocampi was 13.57 Gy, and the average minimum dose was 8.07 Gy.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: When comparing the planned radiation dose with the actual measured dose, the average agreement was 96.43%, and all 15 plans had an agreement rate above 95%.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The study concludes that creating these treatment plans on the specific MRI-linac system is technically feasible and that the delivery accuracy is supported by the quality assurance tests.
facts.subject: other
